episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In the 1970s, Emma faces a coup. Back in 1911, young Emma grapples with forbidden romance.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Emma and Edwin fall deeper in love, while Adam and Olivia embark on their own affair.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Will Emma leave Fairley - and Edwin - for good? Adele's sobriety re-ignites her marriage.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Emma builds a new life in Armley. And in the 1970s, Emma confronts her eldest daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Emma's tempted by romance for the first time since Edwin. Paula faces an ultimatum.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Emma's obsession with work and revenge brings danger to her door.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Britain is at war, and Emma takes a gamble that could cost her far more than her business.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Young Emma battles to stay afloat, but would she really get into bed with the Fairleys?
